scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Only abstract groups of F2-rational automorphisms are identified; no claim concerning automorphism group schemes, larger finite fields, or a contradiction to characteristic-zero algebraic-group rigidity. A structurally explicit nonisomorphism and full group isomorphism are proved. Related literature may use alternative small-local-ring terminology; independent publication-priority certification is not claimed.
title: Five-dimensional monomial algebras with indistinguishable finite automorphism groups
